Agent: Good to meet you, Leo. What's the business?

Agent: Emergency work lives or dies on speed. When a call comes in today, what happens to it?
User: Calls come in and whoever's free grabs them, honestly.
Agent: Here's the thing — no form. You already gave me all of it. That's Convert: every call-out answered and booked while your team is on a job.
User: Okay, that's actually useful.
